title: Synergistic wound healing effects of Hibiscus rosa-sinensis and Centella asiatica extracts combination (HRCSA): in vivo and 3D organotypic models
core_idea: Assess histological and molecular effects of a combined Hibiscus rosa-sinensis and Centella asiatica extract (HRCSA) on wound healing using a rat excisional wound model and a human 3D organotypic skin model, measuring wound closure, tensile strength, and expression of wound-healing genes after topical treatment.
tldr: This study tests whether a combination extract of Hibiscus rosa-sinensis and Centella asiatica (HRCSA) influences wound-healing processes by applying it to rat excisional wounds and a 3D human skin model and evaluating tissue repair and gene-expression changes.
